Description: At night, after Tony Dauer falls asleep in his room, an unknown intruder enters through a secret door, opens a drawer and takes something, then leaves without waking Tony. The narrator confirms Edmund Galley stayed awake all night and was active in the Living room.
Location: Tony Dauer's room（Tony's room）
Key Information:
  - At night, Tony Dauer returns to his own room, locks the door, and falls asleep.
  - Tony Dauer makes several preparations before bed, then quickly falls into a deep sleep and starts snoring.
  - A secret door opens during the night, and someone enters Tony Dauer’s room.
  - The intruder pauses beside the bed, opens a drawer, and then leaves the room.
  - Throughout the incident Tony Dauer is never awakened; the door is opened again and closed when the intruder leaves.
  - This night intrusion directly corresponds to Tony Dauer’s earlier report that his gun went missing.
  - The narrator explicitly states that Person No. 6 Edmund Galley remained awake all night and stayed in the Living room.
  - The narrator adds that Edmund Galley began a new day at time point 14, unlike everyone else’s night state.
Characters:
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, Helen Dauer’s son.
    · Sleeps in his room at night with the door locked from inside.
    · Remains asleep throughout the intrusion.
    · His room drawer is searched at night, corresponding to his missing gun.
  [Edmund Galley（Edmund Galley）] Person No. 6, the male head of the villa.
    · Is explicitly stated by the narrator to have stayed awake all night.
    · Stayed in the Living room overnight.
    · Being awake gives him the time window for night actions.
